findings.text: Zero leads across all 28 days despite 131 Google clicks and 654 GA4 sessions — conversion tracking is broken, not absent demand.
CPL is incalculable; $621.80 spent with 0 recorded conversions. 3-day spend (Aug 28–30: $21.62, $1.38, $6.86) is collapsing — budget or bidding cut likely in response to zero returns.
SOW milestone 'Stripe Products QA'd & Done' (due 2026-07-20) shows no confirmed verified event — Becklar billing drop and BWS duplicate checks remain unverified per SOW.
GBP generated 49 direction requests and 0 calls in 28 days. Search clicks dropped -36.36% week-over-week (last 3 days: 0, 0, 0) — organic is also degrading.
GHL shows 137 opportunities created but 0 leads from ads and 0 appointments — pipeline likely populated by non-ad sources; intake path integrity unconfirmed.

suggestions.text: Audit and repair Google Ads conversion tracking immediately — 131 clicks, $621.80 spent, 0 conversions is a pixel/tag failure.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads has spent $621.80 over 28 days and recorded 0 conversions from 131 clicks — this is a confirmed tracking failure, not a demand problem. Action: audit the Google Ads conversion tag and GA4 goal configuration on the landing page this week; verify a test conversion fires end-to-end. Success is confirmed when at least one conversion event registers in both Google Ads and GA4 within 48 hours of the fix. Do not scale or kill any campaigns until tracking is verified.

suggestions.text: Hold all budget scaling until conversion tracking is verified; re-check spend trend (Aug 28–30 avg $9.91/day) in 3 days.
suggestions.monday_update: Spend has dropped sharply in the last 3 days (Aug 28: $21.62, Aug 29: $1.38, Aug 30: $6.86), averaging $9.91/day versus $19.69 on Aug 27. No scaling or budget shifts should be made until the tracking fix (S1) is confirmed live. Re-check on 2026-09-03 to assess whether spend has stabilized and whether conversions are now recording.
